name: Game board: versus grid
when: The voice compares two games on the same few things (their helicopters, motorbikes, boats; their cops, their maps' landmarks). One row per game with its logo and year, one column per thing with its name on top; each column lands on the word that names that thing, both games' photos at once, so the eye reads across.
anchor: at1, at2, at3: each column lands on the word that names its thing. The scene ends 0.23 s after `out`.
placement: Full screen on the video's ground: mount ground-B (clean) or ground-A (vice) under it with the same --start and the same length. Cut into it from the shot before and out of it to the next shot (the board is its own shot).

vars.theme: clean (on ground-B, white text, white card frames) or vice (on ground-A, ink text, gradient card frames): the video's theme
vars.game1: the first game, as logos.json names it (Grand Theft Auto IV); game2 the second
vars.logo1: its logo file: filled from assets/logos/ by build_video.mjs when game1 is listed there; logo2 the same. A logo is never drawn or invented
vars.year1: its release year (2008), shown with its logo; empty = none. year2 the same
vars.thing1: the first thing both games are compared on, one or two words (Helicopter); thing2 and thing3 the next ones
vars.a1: the first game's photo of thing1: each photo is a still of that game's own footage showing that thing, 16:9, cut with ffmpeg -ss T -i <shot> -frames:v 1 -vf "crop=<w>:<h>:<x>:<y>,scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos" -q:v 2 a1.jpg (crop so the thing fills most of the card). A thing with no clear still in one of the two games is left out of the board (the owner, 17 Nov 2026: skip what is too precise to source), never filled with another game's still or a drawing. a2, a3 the first game's next things; b1 to b3 the second game's
vars.thing3: the third thing; empty = a two-column board, centred
vars.at1: seconds after the start: the first column lands (0.5); at2 and at3 the next ones, each at least 0.5 s apart
vars.out: seconds after the start: everything fades out together (5.0); hold at least 1 s after the last column

lab: Not validated yet (built 17 Nov 2026 for the owner's note: 'if the video compares the vehicles of San Andreas and GTA IV, a picture of a helicopter in both games, a bike in both, a boat in both, on a stylish ground in our colours, motion-graphic infographics like Roddy Games'). Not in catalogue.md until he picks A, B or C.
source: new, built in the skills repo (owner, 17 Nov 2026)
